title: Libraries and reading rooms in Kochi
description: Find public reading rooms, lending libraries and quiet study spaces in Kochi, with access notes and map links.
intro: Looking for a place to read, borrow books or study? These Kochi-area libraries and study spaces do different jobs: a lending library is not necessarily a place to spend the day, and a paid study room may not lend books. Access, membership fees and hours can change, so check with the venue before visiting. Map links are searches, not verified pins.

entries.name: Ernakulam Public Library
entries.details: Public reading and lending · Convent Road
entries.description: The library describes a general newspaper reading room for non-members, a separate members’ reading room, and reference and children’s sections.
entries.address: Library Buildings, Convent Road, Ernakulam, Kochi 682035

facts.label: Reading
facts.value: The library says non-members can read newspapers in the general room; confirm current access.

facts.label: Borrowing
facts.value: Membership is needed to borrow; confirm current fees.

entries.name: EMS Co-operative Library
entries.description: A community library in Mavelipuram with general reading and reference collections. Local reporting describes family, student and institutional memberships.
entries.address: MRA Hall Road, Mavelipuram, Kakkanad, Kochi 682030

facts.label: Borrowing
facts.value: Membership options include family and student plans; check current terms.

facts.label: Reading on site
facts.value: Ask the library about access for non-members.

entries.name: Chavara Public Library
entries.details: Public reading room and lending · Ernakulam South
entries.description: The library lists a reading and reference area, plus general and children’s memberships. An older cultural-centre page describes a public newspaper reading room; confirm present access and fees.

facts.label: Reading

entries.name: Eloor Lending Library
entries.description: A long-established lending library with a Kochi branch. The operator lists its branch on Press Club Road; ask about the current membership and whether there is space to read on site.
entries.address: First Floor, Press Club Road, Ernakulam, Kochi 682011

facts.label: Borrowing
facts.value: The library describes membership and a non-member borrowing option; confirm current terms.

ordering.explanation: Editor’s starting points: Ernakulam Public Library and EMS Co-operative Library come first, based on their documented services and local reader discussions. The remaining places follow alphabetically. This is not a review-score ranking.
